AI_ANALYTICS.TITLE: AI Analytics
AI_ANALYTICS.SUBTITLE: Track the performance, usage, and consumption of your AI assistants.
AI_ANALYTICS.HANDOFF_RATE_INFO: Handed-off conversations divided by conversations handled. With no conversations in the period there is no rate.
AI_ANALYTICS.EMPTY_TOOLS: No tool executions in this period.
AI_ANALYTICS.EMPTY: No AI activity found in this period.
AI_ANALYTICS.EMPTY_KNOWLEDGE: No knowledge queries in this period.
AI_ANALYTICS.INSUFFICIENT: Insufficient data to calculate this metric.
AI_ANALYTICS.TURNS_HELP: Model responses generated, regardless of the number of messages sent.
AI_ANALYTICS.HIT_HELP: Queries with at least one accepted chunk divided by all queries.
AI_ANALYTICS.UTILIZATION_HELP: Conversations with accepted knowledge chunks divided by conversations handled.
AI_ANALYTICS.CREDITS_HELP: Credits consumed divided by conversations handled.
AI_ANALYTICS.CONVERSATIONS_INFO: Conversations where the AI sent at least one reply in the period, following the agent and inbox filters.
AI_ANALYTICS.MESSAGES_INFO: Public messages sent by this platform's AI agents, within the chosen filters. A reply split into several messages counts several times here and once in AI turns. The AI vs people chart counts every public reply from the AI and from bots, by month and without these filters, so the numbers can differ.
AI_ANALYTICS.MESSAGES_INFO_BOTS: In this period, {count} replies from other bots (without the AI agent mark) appear there and not here.
AI_ANALYTICS.HANDOFFS_INFO: Conversations handled by the AI with a recorded handoff to a person. A handoff is an event: the conversation stays "AI only" in the AI vs people chart until a person actually replies in it.
AI_ANALYTICS.TOKENS_INFO: Input and output tokens of every AI turn in the period. The cost is an estimate from the model's list price.
AI_ANALYTICS.TIMESERIES_INFO: Messages sent, AI turns and conversations handled per day. Hover, tap or use the arrow keys to see a day; it opens on the busiest day.
AI_ANALYTICS.TIMESERIES_SCROLL: Activity chart per day. Use the arrow keys to change the day.
AI_ANALYTICS.OUTCOME_INFO: Of the conversations handled by the AI, how many went on without a handoff and how many were handed off to a person.
AI_ANALYTICS.TURNS_PER_CONVERSATION_INFO: AI turns divided by conversations handled.
AI_ANALYTICS.CONSUMPTION_INFO: Tokens the model received (input) and wrote (output) in the AI turns of the period.
AI_ANALYTICS.COST_INFO: Estimated from the model's list price ({prices} per 1M tokens).
AI_ANALYTICS.COST_INFO_NO_PRICE: There is no price set for the model in use, so the cost cannot be estimated.
AI_ANALYTICS.TOKENS_PER_DAY_ARIA: Tokens per day, the strongest day highlighted
AI_ANALYTICS.TOKENS_CALLOUT: Each AI turn sends ≈ {input} input tokens and generates ≈ {output} output tokens.
AI_ANALYTICS.TOOLS_INFO: Tool executions by the AI in real conversations (not the Playground) and how many succeeded.
AI_ANALYTICS.KNOWLEDGE_INFO: Queries the AI made to the knowledge bases and whether they found a useful passage.
AI_ANALYTICS.UNANSWERED_EMPTY: No question was left without a result.
AI_ANALYTICS.DETAILS_INFO: One day per row, most recent first. Days follow the time zone set for the reports of the account (UTC when none).
AI_ANALYTICS.TOTAL_NOTE: * Unique conversations in the period. The daily sum can be larger, because a conversation spans more than one day.

GENERAL_DASHBOARD.TITLE: Dashboard
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.SUBTITLE: Customer service, AI, team, sales and broadcasts in one place.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.KPI_ACTIVITY_INFO: Conversations where the customer or the team sent a message in the period, even if they started earlier. It does not depend on anyone resolving the conversation.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.KPI_FIRST_RESPONSE_INFO: How long customers waited, on average, for the first reply (from a person) in the period. The median is the time of the "typical" customer, not pulled up by very long waits.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.KPI_COST_INFO: Estimated cost in dollars (the model's list price) divided by the conversations the AI handled in the period. With no price set for the model there is no estimate.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.KPI_WON_INFO: Deals that became "won" in the period, in the chosen pipeline. The outcome of a lead is the deal, not the conversation.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.WAITING_INFO: Customers who wrote and have not received an answer yet, from a person or from the AI. This is the situation right now, not of the period. Resolved or snoozed conversations are left out.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.WAITING_NONE: Nobody is waiting. Everything is answered.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.WAITING_OLDEST: the oldest has been waiting for {time}
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.REPLIES_INFO: Public replies sent to customers per day, split between the AI (and bots) and people. Replies from automations are not counted.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.REPLIES_ARIA: Replies per day, from the AI and from people
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.HEATMAP_INFO: New conversations by weekday and hour, on the account's clock.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.HEATMAP_ARIA: Heat map of the {count} new conversations by weekday and hour
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.AI_INFO: How much of the service the AI is taking over. The same numbers as the AI analytics, for the same period.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.AI_OFF: The AI is not enabled on this account.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.AI_REPLIES_SHARE_INFO: Public replies from the AI and from bots divided by all public replies in the period.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.AI_ONLY_INFO: Conversations where only the AI replied, divided by the conversations with a reply in the period. A recorded handoff does not take the conversation out of here until a person replies in it.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.HANDOFFS_INFO: Conversations handled by the AI with a handoff to a person recorded in the period.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.KNOWLEDGE_SUMMARY: Knowledge base: {rate} with a result ({count} queries)
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.TEAM_INFO: The people who replied to customers in the period. No resolution SLA, because it depends on someone resolving the conversation.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.TEAM_EMPTY: No person replied to customers in the period.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.CRM_INFO: The outcome of a lead is the deal: won, lost, or in which stage it is. The funnel is as of now; won and lost are of the period. It does not use the inbox filter.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.CRM_EMPTY: No active pipeline in the CRM.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.FUNNEL_NOW: Open deals right now, by stage
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.WIN_RATE_INFO: Deals won divided by the ones closed (won + lost) in the period.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.BLASTS_INFO: Messages sent by broadcasts in the period, how many arrived and how many customers wrote after receiving one. Only broadcasts that record their recipients (WhatsApp) are counted.
GENERAL_DASHBOARD.BLASTS_EMPTY: No broadcast sent in the period.

CRM_API_DOCS.TITLE: CRM API documentation
CRM_API_DOCS.DESCRIPTION: Reference for integrating pipelines, stages, deals, activities, notes and custom fields with this account's CRM.
CRM_API_DOCS.BASE_URL_DESCRIPTION: Replace :account_id with the account ID and use the origin of this installation.
CRM_API_DOCS.AUTH_DESCRIPTION: Send an account API access token in every request. The token must have API access enabled for the account.
CRM_API_DOCS.AUTH_WARNING: Never expose API tokens in browser code, public tools, logs or documentation shared with customers.
CRM_API_DOCS.PIPELINES_DESCRIPTION: Create and manage the account's sales funnels. Listing and reading include the pipeline stages.
CRM_API_DOCS.STAGES_DESCRIPTION: Stages belong to one pipeline. Positions are ordered from lowest to highest and probability must be an integer from 0 to 100.
CRM_API_DOCS.DEALS_DESCRIPTION: A deal is the CRM card linked to a contact, pipeline and stage. List results are ordered by creation date when no search is used.
CRM_API_DOCS.CUSTOM_FIELDS_DESCRIPTION: Define fields for the account and read or update their values on individual deals.
CRM_API_DOCS.ACTIVITIES_DESCRIPTION: Schedule tasks, calls, meetings and follow-ups. Google Calendar synchronization is available for meetings when configured.
CRM_API_DOCS.EVENTS_DESCRIPTION: Read the deal timeline and create, edit or delete notes. Notes are limited to 10,000 characters.
CRM_API_DOCS.CALENDAR_DESCRIPTION: Check, start or remove the authenticated user's personal Google Calendar connection.
CRM_API_DOCS.LIST_PIPELINES: List all pipelines and their stages.
CRM_API_DOCS.SHOW_PIPELINE: Get one pipeline and its stages.
CRM_API_DOCS.CREATE_STAGE: Create a stage in a pipeline.
CRM_API_DOCS.REORDER_STAGES: Replace the complete stage order using stage_ids.
CRM_API_DOCS.LIST_DEALS: List deals. Supports pipeline_id, contact_id and q filters.
CRM_API_DOCS.SHOW_DEAL: Get one deal with contact, owner, pipeline and custom fields.
CRM_API_DOCS.UPDATE_CUSTOM_FIELD: Update a custom field. The key cannot be changed.
CRM_API_DOCS.DELETE_CUSTOM_FIELD: Delete or deactivate a custom field.
CRM_API_DOCS.SHOW_DEAL_VALUES: Get the active custom fields and their values for a deal.
CRM_API_DOCS.UPDATE_DEAL_VALUES: Update deal values with an object keyed by field key.
CRM_API_DOCS.RETRY_ACTIVITY: Retry a pending Google Calendar synchronization.
CRM_API_DOCS.LIST_EVENTS: List deal events. Supports page pagination.
CRM_API_DOCS.UPDATE_NOTE: Edit a note created by the authenticated user.
CRM_API_DOCS.SHOW_CALENDAR: Get the current user's Calendar connection status.
CRM_API_DOCS.CONNECT_CALENDAR: Start the Google Calendar OAuth flow and receive its URL.
CRM_API_DOCS.DISCONNECT_CALENDAR: Disconnect the current user's Google Calendar.
CRM_API_DOCS.PIPELINE_BODY_HELP: won_automations and lost_automations accept up to 10 validated automation actions.
CRM_API_DOCS.STAGE_BODY_HELP: ai_instructions are used by AI Agent CRM flows. automations use the same action format as outcome automations.
CRM_API_DOCS.DEAL_BODY_HELP: pipeline_id, pipeline_stage_id and contact_id must belong to the same account; the stage must belong to the selected pipeline.
CRM_API_DOCS.ACTIVITY_BODY_HELP: activity_type accepts task, call, meeting or follow_up. duration_minutes is an integer from 1 to 1440.
CRM_API_DOCS.CUSTOM_FIELD_BODY_HELP: field_type accepts text, textarea, number, currency, date, datetime, boolean, select or multiselect. Select fields require options.
CRM_API_DOCS.AUTOMATION_BODY_HELP: Supported action types include set_status, assign_owner, create_activity, add_label, set_ai_state, send_message, move_stage and send_webhook.
CRM_API_DOCS.RESPONSE_HELP: Deal responses include the linked contact, owner, pipeline stage and custom field values. Event lists return payload and meta.has_more.
CRM_API_DOCS.FILTER_CONTACT: return deals linked to one contact
CRM_API_DOCS.FILTER_SEARCH: search by deal or contact data
CRM_API_DOCS.FILTER_EVENTS_PAGE: read the next page of timeline events
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_ACCOUNT_SCOPE: Every resource is scoped to the account in the URL. Cross-account contacts, users, pipelines and stages are rejected.
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_PIPELINE_SCOPE: A pipeline with deals cannot be deleted. A stage with deals must be emptied or moved before deletion.
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_STAGE_SCOPE: Stage reorder must include every stage exactly once.
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_ACTIVITY: Meetings synced to Google Calendar can only be changed by the connected calendar owner.
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_NOTES: Notes require non-empty text and are limited to 10,000 characters.
CRM_API_DOCS.RULE_ERRORS: Validation failures return HTTP 422; unauthorized or inaccessible resources return the standard authorization response.
